/*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */ </style> <style id="bps-styles-inline-css"> .bps-section {
 width: 100%;
 }
 .bps-grid {
 display: grid;
 grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
 gap: 24px;
 width: 100%;
 align-items: center;
 }
 .bps-item {
 width: 100%;
 display: flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 min-width: 0;
 }
 .bps-item img {
 width: 140px;
 max-width: 100%;
 height: auto;
 display: block;
 }
 @media (max-width: 1024px) {
 .bps-grid {
 grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
 }
 }
 @media (max-width: 767px) {
 .bps-grid {
 grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
 }
 } 
/*# sourceURL=bps-styles-inline-css */ </style> <style id="fiordifrolla-brevo-inline-inline-css"> .ff-brevo-wrap{
 max-width: 760px;
 width: 100%;
 }
 .ff-brevo-form{
 width: 100%;
 margin: 0;
 }
 .ff-brevo-row{
 display: grid;
 grid-template-columns: minmax(140px, 180px) minmax(220px, 1fr) auto;
 gap: 10px;
 align-items: center;
 }
 .ff-brevo-field{
 margin: 0;
 }
 .ff-brevo-input{
 display: block;
 width: 100%;
 height: 42px;
 padding: 0 12px;
 border: 1px solid #d8d8d8;
 border-radius: 8px;
 font-size: 14px;
 line-height: 1;
 box-sizing: border-box;
 background: #fff;
 margin: 0;
 }
 .ff-brevo-input:focus{
 outline: none;
 border-color: #bf1212;
 box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(191,18,18,.08);
 }
 .ff-brevo-submit{
 display: inline-flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 height: 42px;
 padding: 0 18px;
 border: 0;
 border-radius: 8px;
 background: #bf1212;
 color: #fff;
 font-size: 14px;
 font-weight: 600;
 white-space: nowrap;
 cursor: pointer;
 transition: opacity .2s ease;
 }
 .ff-brevo-submit:hover{
 opacity: .92;
 }
 .ff-brevo-submit:disabled{
 opacity: .7;
 cursor: not-allowed;
 }
 .ff-brevo-privacy{
 display: flex;
 align-items: flex-start;
 gap: 8px;
 margin-top: 10px;
 font-size: 12px;
 line-height: 1.4;
 color: #555;
 }
 .ff-brevo-privacy input[type="checkbox"]{
 margin: 2px 0 0;
 flex: 0 0 auto;
 }
 .ff-brevo-message{
 margin-top: 10px;
 font-size: 13px;
 line-height: 1.4;
 }
 .ff-brevo-message--error{
 color: #b00020;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal{
 position: fixed;
 inset: 0;
 z-index: 99999;
 display: none;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 padding: 20px;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal.is-visible{
 display: flex;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__overlay{
 position: absolute;
 inset: 0;
 background: rgba(0,0,0,.45);
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__dialog{
 position: relative;
 width: 100%;
 max-width: 430px;
 background: #fff;
 border-radius: 16px;
 padding: 28px 24px 22px;
 box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
 text-align: center;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__title{
 margin: 0 0 10px;
 font-size: 24px;
 line-height: 1.2;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__text{
 margin: 0 0 18px;
 font-size: 14px;
 line-height: 1.6;
 color: #555;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__close{
 display: inline-flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 min-height: 40px;
 padding: 0 18px;
 border: 0;
 border-radius: 8px;
 background: #bf1212;
 color: #fff;
 font-size: 14px;
 font-weight: 600;
 cursor: pointer;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__x{
 position: absolute;
 top: 10px;
 right: 12px;
 border: 0;
 background: transparent;
 font-size: 24px;
 line-height: 1;
 cursor: pointer;
 color: #888;
 }
 body.ff-brevo-modal-open{
 overflow: hidden;
 }
 @media (max-width: 768px){
 .ff-brevo-row{
 grid-template-columns: 1fr;
 }
 .ff-brevo-input,
 .ff-brevo-submit{
 height: 40px;
 font-size: 13px;
 width: 100%;
 }
 .ff-brevo-privacy{
 font-size: 11px;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__dialog{
 padding: 24px 18px 18px;
 }
 .ff-brevo-modal__title{
 font-size: 21px;
 }
 }
/*# sourceURL=fiordifrolla-brevo-inline-inline-css */ </style> <style id="hacr-front-style-inline-css"> .hacr-section { margin: 40px 0; width: 100%; }
 .titolo-h3-home-adv {
 display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-transform: uppercase;
 font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0 0 24px;
 }
 .titolo-h3-home-adv::after { content: ''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: #666; }
 .hacr-adv-badge {
 display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4px 8px;
 background: #bf1212; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1;
 border-radius: 3px; letter-spacing: 0.03em;
 }
 .hacr-heading-text { display: inline-block; }
 .hacr-carousel-wrap {
 position: relative;
 padding: 10px 16px 14px;
 margin: -10px -16px -14px;
 }
 .hacr-carousel {
 position: relative;
 overflow: hidden;
 width: 100%;
 padding-bottom: 6px;
 }
 .hacr-track { display: flex; will-change: transform; }
 .hacr-slide {
 flex: 0 0 calc(100% / 3);
 padding: 0 12px;
 box-sizing: border-box;
 min-width: 0;
 }
 .hacr-card {
 display: grid;
 grid-template-columns: 9fr 10fr;
 gap: 18px;
 align-items: stretch;
 width: 100%;
 background: #fff;
 border: 1px solid #e8e8e8;
 border-radius: 8px;
 overflow: hidden;
 box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
 text-decoration: none;
 color: inherit;
 min-height: 100%;
 }
 .hacr-media {
 width: 100%;
 aspect-ratio: 9 / 16;
 background: #f3f3f3;
 overflow: hidden;
 }
 .hacr-media img {
 width: 100%;
 height: 100%;
 object-fit: cover;
 object-position: center;
 display: block;
 image-rendering: auto;
 }
 .hacr-content {
 padding: 18px 18px 18px 0;
 display: flex;
 flex-direction: column;
 justify-content: center;
 min-width: 0;
 }
 .hacr-recipe-title {
 margin: 0 0 12px;
 font-size: 22px;
 line-height: 1.15;
 }
 .hacr-excerpt {
 margin: 0 0 14px;
 font-size: 15px;
 line-height: 1.5;
 color: #444;
 }
 .hacr-cta {
 display: inline-flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 width: fit-content;
 padding: 4px 8px;
 border: 1px solid #333;
 background: #fff;
 color: #333;
 font-size: 11px;
 font-weight: 600;
 text-decoration: none;
 white-space: nowrap;
 transition: all 0.2s ease;
 }
 .hacr-card:hover .hacr-cta { background: #333; color: #fff; }
 .hacr-nav {
 position: absolute;
 top: 50%;
 transform: translateY(-50%);
 width: 28px;
 height: 28px;
 border: 0;
 border-radius: 50%;
 background: #bf1212;
 color: #fff;
 display: inline-flex;
 align-items: center;
 justify-content: center;
 cursor: pointer;
 z-index: 5;
 transition: background 0.2s ease;
 padding: 0;
 line-height: 1;
 }
 .hacr-nav:hover { background: #000; }
 .hacr-nav-prev { left: 0; }
 .hacr-nav-next { right: 0; }
 .hacr-nav svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; display: block; }
 @media (max-width: 1024px) {
 .hacr-slide { flex-basis: calc(100% / 2); }
 .hacr-recipe-title { font-size: 20px; }
 }
 @media (max-width: 767px) {
 .hacr-slide { flex-basis: 100%; }
 .hacr-card { grid-template-columns: 9fr 11fr; }
 .hacr-content { padding: 16px 16px 16px 0; }
 .hacr-recipe-title { font-size: 19px; }
 .hacr-excerpt { font-size: 14px; }
 .titolo-h3-home-adv { font-size: 22px; }
 .hacr-nav { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
 .hacr-nav svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
 .hacr-carousel-wrap {
 padding-left: 12px;
 padding-right: 12px;
 margin-left: -12px;
 margin-right: -12px;
 }
 }

 }

No non parlo di un nuovo ragazzo, quello non ci penso neanche a cambiarlo, ma mi riferisco a questa bontà che vedete qui.</p><div><p>La <strong>Bolzano</strong> <strong>Apple</strong> <strong>Cake</strong> è un magnifico dolce creato dallo chef Scott Carsberg di Seattle, io però ho seguito la ricetta di <strong><em>Cookie</em></strong><strong><em>.</em></strong> Non si tratta di una <strong>torta di mele classica</strong> perché ha la particolarità di avere pochissimo impasto e molte <strong>mele</strong>. Inoltre la superficie leggermente croccante contrasta divinamente con l’interno che è morbido e profumatissimo.</p><p>Una volta assaggiato si è verificato esattamente quello che scriveva Cookie, ho abbandonato le altre <strong>ricette di torte di mele</strong> e d’ora in poi questa diverrà la mia preferita! Perfino la mia dolce metà, che come ben sapete adora solo le cheesecake, l’ha apprezzata molto… quindi non posso fare altro che consigliarvi caldamente di provarla, non ne rimarrete affatto
